draftCreated: Draft created — review it in MyPack
draftCreatedBody: Nothing has been built or installed. Review the draft in MyPack, then build it when you are ready.
draftOpenFailed: The draft is saved, but MyPack could not be brought to the front. Open MyPack to review it.
chooseBody: More than one app matches this website. Pick the one you want — MyPack never chooses for you.
restrictedTitle: This page can't become an app
restrictedBody: Only regular web pages (http and https) can be turned into desktop apps. You can still paste a web address straight into MyPack.
hostMissingBody: The Companion needs MyPack Desktop and its small helper on this computer. Nothing was created.
hostStep2: Register the helper with this command:
hostErrorBody: The helper started but could not reach MyPack. Make sure MyPack is installed, then try again. Nothing was created.
protocolBody: This extension and the installed MyPack helper use different versions. Update both to the latest version.
errorUnsupported: This web address can't be used.
errorNotFound: That app is no longer available. Reopen this popup to refresh.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
languageHelp: Choose the language used by the popup and menus.
desktopLanguageUnknown: Connect to MyPack Desktop once to learn its language.
privacyBody: It reads only the address, title and icon of the tab when you click it. It never reads page content, cookies or passwords, and it can only create drafts — MyPack Desktop asks you before anything is built or installed.
